description: Investigates the Hadean crust, possible early oceans and atmosphere through Jack Hills zircons, oxygen and hydrogen isotopes, volatile delivery and loss, and impact history. Examines how water and climate could coexist with a faint young Sun while separating habitability evidence from uncertain reconstructions.
